## TRA Timeline

#### Spin-merger announcement and Annex execution

- 2021-05-17: AT&T executes Tax Matters Agreement with Magallanes (Spinco) and Discovery; Tax Receivable Annex (Annex A) sets 85% sharing of Realized Covered Tax Benefits from a protective Section 336(e) election
- 2021-05-20: 8-K filed disclosing the Tax Matters Agreement as Exhibit 10.4

#### Spin-merger close

- 2022-04-08: Spin-merger closes; Warner Bros. Discovery emerges as RMT Partner and Annex obligor
- 2023-02 (and subsequent 10-Ks): AT&T's annual reports reference the Tax Matters Agreement but do not record a separate Annex receivable, consistent with limited or no Realized Covered Tax Benefits

## Explanation

In May 2021, AT&T entered into a Tax Matters Agreement with Magallanes (Spinco) and Discovery as part of the WarnerMedia spin-merger that created Warner Bros. Discovery on April 8, 2022. Annex A of the Tax Matters Agreement is a Tax Receivable Annex under which Warner Bros. Discovery (as RMT Partner) owes AT&T (as Remainco) 85% of Realized Covered Tax Benefits arising from a protective Section 336(e) election made in connection with the spin-merger, capped at 100% of Remainco's Applicable-Transaction taxes at Assumed Tax Rates. Payment runs annually, within 10 days of an RMT Partner Certification tied to the consolidated federal return. AT&T sits on the beneficiary side; obligor-side accounting lives under Warner Bros. Discovery (CIK 0001437107). The Annex remains in force per AT&T's 2024 10-K. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
